name: Mikogami Toryu
source:
A warrior dispatched from the main Izumo shrine aiming to hunt down and kill Iwanagahime.

[spoiler]Daichi's previous incarnation born from his regret at his lack of strength and inability to kill Iwanagahime. Daichi is the soul which was reincarnated while Toryu is the "vessel" animated by Izumo.[/spoiler]
